issue.title: write_file silently converts CRLF files to LF on overwrite (edit_file preserves, write_file doesn't)

steps:
Use the shell and Python pathlib.Path to create notes.txt with write_bytes(b'first
second
third
'). Create its parent directory if needed. Read it with read_file.
Use write_file to save a corrected copy of notes.txt containing first, updated, third on separate lines. Keep the existing file line-ending style.
expected: Overwriting an existing CRLF file retains CRLF when no conversion was requested.
defect: write_file writes LF replacement text verbatim and silently changes unrelated CRLF line endings.

fault location.explanation: WriteFileTool writes incoming text bytes without consulting the prior file line-ending style, unlike edit_file. PR #5911 adds prior-style restoration to both write paths.

Root cause: WriteFileTool writes incoming text bytes without consulting the prior file line-ending style, unlike edit_file. PR #5911 adds prior-style restoration to both write paths.
